description: One monitor, and what it covers where lemonfiber made it.

active.description: Whether it is checking, rather than only defined.

covers.description:
What it covers, by the record of what lemonfiber provisioned; absent for a monitor
lemonfiber did not make.

heartbeat.description: A heartbeat's interval, grace and last check-in.

last_reading.description: When it last took a reading, in seconds since the Unix epoch, where it ever has.

name.description: Its own name in the watcher.

path.description: Which path an entry point's monitor watches.

since.description: Since when, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

unconfigured.description:
What it was asked to watch and what it watches instead, where it does not watch
what it should.
